name: Stowdrop landing page by stowdrop.app
description: A long dark landing page for a Mac clipboard/snippet app built almost entirely on near-black surfaces with a single orange accent used for eyebrows, key words and CTA buttons. The page opens with a centered hero over a subtle radial glow and an app-window screenshot of the actual library UI, then alternates between full-width feature statements and bento-style cards showing UI panels, tiles and real product photography. Typography is large sans headings with tight leading and per-line alternating emphasis (one word picked out in orange), while body copy stays small and muted gray. Sections step down in rhythm from hero to feature bento rows, a stats band, a keyboard-shortcut table, an FAQ accordion, and a final CTA card, all separated by hairline borders and generous dark spacing.
